epic.title: Harvest rescue: archive, the eleven chats, then the delete gate
epic.description:
Before any old Claude project is deleted, everything durable is rescued into `claude/archive/`: the project docs (the office design state, both email plans, the PhirstMaxxing roadmap and prompts) and the files that live only in chats (the Daytripper spec, Alex's brochure and plan, DropShipAuto's tracker and plan files). The eleven chats the harvests could not read get the one-chat harvest; so do the 41 unread chats outside projects (first five first) and the three projects nobody swept. Then Claude checks the tickets against every harvest, project by project, and only then does Phil delete the old projects. Both Everlight projects and Mycelium are kept. `claude/harvest-prompts-rescue.md` (which the brief names for Prompts C and D) and `claude/harvest-review.md` do not exist in the repo; they were never committed or were deleted. Phil or a later session recreates them. Prompt A (the project sweep) is `claude/harvest-prompt.md`; Prompt C (the one-chat harvest, pasted into the chat itself) and Prompt D (the project export) were in the missing file; rescue.01 step 1.1 has Claude Code recreate it, and the guides carry a working draft meanwhile.

## Order
rescue.01 and rescue.02 first (the archive), with rescue.03 alongside. rescue.04 and rescue.05 any time; the first sitting of rescue.04 matters most. rescue.06 waits for rescue.01 and rescue.03 (and reads rescue.04 and rescue.05 if done). rescue.07 last, after rescue.06.

## Done means
`claude/archive/` holds every project doc and chat-only file named in H8; every unread chat has a harvest file or is noted empty; rescue.06's table marks each project fully filed; the old projects are deleted with a full claude.ai export saved first; Everlight and Mycelium are still there.

## Flags
- Run rules `[claude]`: a full breakdown of future work goes stale. Complied with.

## Dossier
The dossier is attached in Docs: (link filled by the integrator).

Phil or a later session recreates them. Prompt D's purpose: make a project print every doc in its knowledge and every file its chats made, word for word, so Phil can save them. The guide carries a draft of it until the file is recreated.

## Why
H8.1: rescue everything into `claude/archive/` first; Phil runs one short export prompt per project.

`claude/archive/` has a folder per project holding the files listed above (or a note of what could not be exported); the account inventory spreadsheet is not in the repo.

- rescue.07: the delete gate
